<thought>We have a single ¹H NMR signal at 7.51 ppm integrating to 10 protons, characteristic of ten equivalent aromatic hydrogens. The simplest organic molecule that fits this description is biphenyl (C₁₂H₁₀), which shows overlapping aromatic resonances around 7.5 ppm. Therefore the SMILES string is "c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2".</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1-c2ccccc2</final_answer>
